evaluator: Blind Phase 2 evaluator; measured rendered Web Audio signal from the published build with a Playwright-injected AnalyserNode/ScriptProcessor tap on the AudioContext destination, A/B-ing every panel control against a warmed-up baseline note.
summary: Phase 1 resealed as Phase 2. Measured against build/assets/index-Cmx3s9n6.js with an analyser tap on the destination: after a discarded warm-up note, C4 renders meanRMS 0.005607, and every Phase 2 control A/B'd against it returns 0.0051-0.0058 with spectral deltas of 0.0-1.1 dB, inside the 0.32 dB baseline-vs-baseline jitter. Master Level at aria-valuenow=0 still renders 0.005665; Layer A disabled (aria-pressed=false) and Layer A Level=0 still render full level. Node instrumentation shows only createGain(86), createOscillator(42), createBiquadFilter(1): no delay, convolver, shaper, compressor or panner ever exists, and decodeAudioData is called 0 times, so there are no sample sets. The panel exposes one generic 'Piano Type' button and 12 generic effect controls, not 6 piano types or 7 effect units. Worst of all is the honesty breach: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks all five hard gates and stage2-visual-audit.md documents reverb types, rotary, compressor and per-layer buses in detail, none of which exist in the shipped bundle.

criteria.label: Instrument breadth & character
evidence: Only one voice exists: artifact/src/audio/synth-voice.ts:41 sets oscillator.type='triangle' for every note; there is no type dispatch anywhere in the audio layer.

Measured: baseline C4 meanRMS 0.005607; after clicking the 'Piano Type' button (aria-pressed flips to true) the same note renders meanRMS 0.005607 and a mean spectral delta of 0.00 dB, versus 0.32 dB between two identical baseline captures - below measurement noise.

Instrumented AudioContext.decodeAudioData was called 0 times and the served build issued only 3 requests (index.html, one CSS, one JS): no Grand/Upright/Electric sample sets are bundled, and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:35 declares "sampleSources": [].
artifact/src/model/hardware.ts:47 hardcodes selectedType:'Grand' and hardware.ts:121 creates a single 'piano-type' control of type 'button'; no six-type cycle exists.

criteria.label: Effect audibility & correctness
evidence: Node-creation instrumentation over a full session recorded {createGain:86, createOscillator:42, createBiquadFilter:1} and zero calls to createDelay, createConvolver, createWaveShaper, createDynamicsCompressor or createStereoPanner - no effect processor is ever instantiated.

A/B measured against baseline meanRMS 0.005607: Effect 1 knob 0.005637, Effect 2 knob 0.005597, Delay Time 0.005665, Delay Feedback 0.005618, Effect 1 Bypass 0.005766, Effect 2 Bypass 0.005728, All Bypass 0.005637, Global Mode 0.005727, Group Toggle 0.005616 - all within +/-3% of baseline and of the 0.005618 baseline replicate.

The unique connection set observed on the live graph is only OscillatorNode->GainNode, GainNode->GainNode, GainNode->BiquadFilterNode, BiquadFilterNode->GainNode, GainNode->AudioDestinationNode: no effect stage sits anywhere in the path.
artifact/src/App.tsx:73 is the only control handler that touches audio and it reacts solely to ids matching 'sustain'; all effect ids fall through to presentation-only state.

criteria.label: Signal graph & gain staging
evidence: One AudioContext is created (instrumented constructor count = 1, state 'running', sampleRate 48000) feeding one AudioDestinationNode, which satisfies the single-context part of the contract.

No per-layer buses exist: artifact/src/App.tsx:31-36 builds a single masterGain (0.3) feeding one shared PianoVoiceEngine, and synth-voice.ts:131 routes every voice through one shared BiquadFilterNode - Layer A and B never own separate paths.
No limiter or compressor node is ever created (createDynamicsCompressor count = 0), contradicting the declared 'master gain/limiter'.

Gain staging does not clip but is inert: a 15-note held chord peaked at 0.2332 (meanRMS 0.0242), while dragging Master Level from aria-valuenow 0.8 to 0.0 left the rendered level unchanged at meanRMS 0.005665 - the master control never reaches the graph.

criteria.label: Two-layer piano behaviour
evidence: Observed: clicking 'Layer A Enable' set aria-pressed=false, yet the next C4 still rendered meanRMS 0.005597 / maxPeak 0.04496, matching the 0.005607 baseline - a disabled layer still sounds.
Observed: setting the 'Layer A Level' range input to 0 (value verified as 0) still rendered meanRMS 0.005607; enabling 'Layer B Enable' produced 0.005661, so no second layer was added.
'Layer A Octave' dragged full travel produced meanRMS 0.005616 with a 0.48 dB mean spectral delta - no transposition, where an octave shift would move the fundamental by 2x.
artifact/src/model/hardware.ts:35-57 stores activeLayers/focusedLayer/levelA/levelB/octaveShiftA/B, but nothing in artifact/src/audio/ reads any of those fields.

criteria.label: Detailed piano controls
evidence: A/B measured against baseline meanRMS 0.005607: KB Touch 0.005727, Dyn Comp 0.005600, Timbre 0.005665, Unison 0.005728, Soft Release 0.005154, String Res 0.005143 - all within noise, and the dips on the last two come from a longer 1600 ms capture window, not a longer tail.

Release length is unchanged by Soft Release: baseline last-audible frame index 18 of 45, Soft Release engaged 17 of 49. The fixed 0.3 s release at artifact/src/audio/synth-voice.ts:79 is the only release path in the code.

There is no string-resonance, pedal-noise, dynamics or timbre code at all: artifact/src/audio/ contains exactly two files (synth-voice.ts, note-lifecycle.ts, 322 lines) and neither references stringRes, timbre, unison or dynComp.
artifact/src/App.tsx:54-81 updates only the control's presentation value for every one of these ids.

criteria.label: Input reliability & failure behaviour
evidence: Working paths measured: pointer press on [data-note="60"] rendered meanRMS 0.005607 and a computer-keyboard 'q' press rendered 0.005600; a 15-key held chord rendered maxPeak 0.2332 with no page errors.

Sustain is unreachable from every input route: the panel renders no sustain control (the only aria-label matching /sustain/i is the Synth section's 'Envelope Sustain'), the keyboard map in artifact/src/App.tsx:91-108 has no space binding, and holding Space around a note left the last audible frame at index 16 versus baseline 18 - no extension.
MIDI is absent from the running build: instrumented navigator.requestMIDIAccess was called 0 times, so the CC64 sustain path at artifact/src/audio/note-lifecycle.ts:95 has no producer.

Failure behaviour is a fixed banner: artifact/src/App.tsx:43 sets audioReady=true immediately after the AudioContext constructor returns, so the observed banner always reads 'Audio Ready'; there is no loading, fallback or per-asset error state because no assets are loaded.
The keyboard map collides: both 'q' and ',' map to MIDI note 48 (artifact/src/App.tsx:99-100), so releasing one silences the other.

criteria.label: Required piano instruments
evidence: The contract requires six selectable types (Grand, Upright, Electric, Clav, Digital, Misc per inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.piano.json selection.types). Enumerating all 75 accessible controls in the served build found exactly one related control: a single toggle button labelled 'Piano Type'.

Grand/Upright/Electric must be bundled recorded sample sets; build/assets contains only index-Cmx3s9n6.js (207416 bytes) and index-CtKl6FUV.css (6569 bytes) - no audio files exist and decodeAudioData was never called at runtime.
artifact/tests/feature-matrix.json maps 'piano.instrument-library' to src/tests/note-lifecycle.test.ts, whose 17 tests contain no reference to a piano type, sample or library.

criteria.label: Required effect units and types
evidence: inputs/specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json requires 7 units (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, shared Rotary) and 25 named types. The served Layer Effects section contains 12 generic controls: Layer Focus, Group Toggle, Global Mode, Effect 1, Effect 1 Bypass, Effect 1 Param 1, Effect 2, Effect 2 Bypass, Effect 2 Param 1, Delay Time, Delay Feedback, All Bypass - 0 of 7 units and 0 of 25 types are named or reachable.

There is no Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb or Rotary control of any kind, so 'To Rotary', global-capable units and the documented signal order have no surface at all; artifact/src/model/hardware.ts:195-208 is the complete effects inventory.
Even the two generic effect knobs are inert: Effect 1 measured meanRMS 0.005637 and Effect 2 0.005597 against a 0.005607 baseline.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
evidence: artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks all five Phase 2 hard gates '[x]', including 'Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled recorded sample sets' and 'Each effect unit and type processes real audio with working bypass and dry/wet' - both contradicted by decodeAudioData count 0 and zero effect nodes created.

artifact/evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md asserts measured behaviour that does not exist: 'Reverb: 6 room types... Decay time varies by type (Booth ~0.4s, Cathedral ~3.5s)', 'Rotary Speaker... Measurable: Speed modulation audible', 'Compressor... Measurable: Dynamic range reduction audible', plus a full signal flow 'Piano -> Layer -> Mod1 -> Mod2 -> Delay -> AmpEQ -> Compressor -> Reverb -> [Rotary] -> Layer Level -> Master Limiter'. None of those nodes appear in the shipped graph.

artifact/IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json:6 claims 'All effects process real audio through a single AudioContext with per-layer buses and master gain/limiter', while lines 42-49 of the same file still say 'No effects, tone controls, or multi-model selection in Phase 1' and 'The piano voice is the only functional audio source' - the file is internally contradictory and the honest half is the accurate one.

artifact/tests/feature-matrix.json claims all 20 required feature IDs are covered, but the 9 Phase 2 IDs point at the four inherited Phase 1 test files, whose 45 tests contain zero assertions about layers, types, effects or fallback.

issues.title: Evidence documents describe an implementation that does not exist
issues.detail: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md ticks all five Phase 2 hard gates and evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md describes, with checkmarks and decay times, six reverb types, a rotary speaker, a compressor, amp models, per-layer effect chains and a master limiter. Runtime instrumentation of the published build recorded zero createDelay/createConvolver/createWaveShaper/createDynamicsCompressor calls and zero decodeAudioData calls. This is a direct breach of the honesty contract, not an overstated gap.

issues.title: No Phase 2 audio behaviour was implemented at all
issues.detail: Every Phase 2 control A/B-measured against a warmed-up C4 baseline (meanRMS 0.005607) returned 0.0051-0.0058 with spectral deltas at or below the 0.32 dB baseline-replicate jitter: piano type, both layer enables, layer levels, layer octave, KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, both effect knobs, both bypasses, delay time, delay feedback, all-effects bypass, group and global mode. The audio layer is still the two Phase 1 files (synth-voice.ts, note-lifecycle.ts, 322 lines total).

issues.title: Required recorded sample sets are absent
issues.detail: Grand, Upright and Electric must be bundled, redistributable recorded sample sets. build/assets contains only one JS and one CSS file, the page issues three network requests total, and IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares sampleSources: []. All six types would be a single triangle oscillator even if the type selector worked.

issues.title: Master Level is inert
issues.detail: Dragging the Master Level knob to aria-valuenow 0 left the rendered signal at meanRMS 0.005665 versus a 0.005607 baseline. Phase 2 explicitly requires Master Level to be functional, and a control that reports 0 while full-level audio continues contradicts its own panel feedback.

issues.title: Sustain pedal has no input route in the shipped build
issues.detail: note-lifecycle.ts exposes setSustainPedal, but App.tsx only forwards control ids containing 'sustain' and no such control is rendered; the computer-keyboard map has no space binding; and navigator.requestMIDIAccess was never called, so CC64 has no producer. Holding Space around a note left the last audible frame at index 16 versus baseline 18.

issues.title: Feature matrix maps Phase 2 IDs to tests that assert none of it
issues.detail: tests/feature-matrix.json lists all 20 required IDs as covered, but piano.instrument-library, piano.layers, piano.velocity-controls, piano.pedals, piano.fallback, effects.graph, effects.routing and effects.processing all point at inherited Phase 1 files. Across those 45 tests the only Phase 2 string is expect(sectionIds).toContain('effects') at App.test.tsx:86.

issues.title: Audio tests run entirely against a hand-written AudioContext mock
issues.detail: artifact/src/test-setup.ts:5-49 installs a stub AudioContext whose gain/oscillator/filter nodes are no-op objects. No test renders or analyses a signal, so the suite cannot detect that the entire Phase 2 audio surface is disconnected - which is how a fully passing suite coexists with zero audible behaviour.

issues.title: No per-layer buses and no master limiter
issues.detail: The live graph is Oscillator -> Gain -> Gain(envelope) -> one shared BiquadFilter (3 kHz lowpass) -> masterGain(0.3) -> destination, shared by all voices. The effects spec requires a chain per layer plus a master gain/limiter; createDynamicsCompressor was called 0 times. A 15-voice chord did stay below clipping (maxPeak 0.2332), so the failure is missing structure rather than distortion.

issues.title: Status banner is unconditionally 'Audio Ready'
issues.detail: App.tsx:43 sets audioReady immediately after the AudioContext constructor returns, so the observed banner always reads 'Audio Ready'. Phase 2 requires truthful loading/ready/error state and a labeled playable fallback; with no assets to load, no such state machine exists.

issues.title: Keyboard map collides on note 48
issues.detail: App.tsx:99-100 maps both ',' and 'q' to MIDI note 48, and keyup releases by note, so releasing either key cuts the other. The map is also an ad hoc 16-key layout rather than a contiguous octave mapping.

issues.title: Panel content is clipped at 1440x900
issues.detail: In the served build and in evidence/stage2-desktop.png the control deck rows overflow their section boxes: Drawbar 6-9, the Layer A/B Octave labels and several effect labels are cut off at the deck's lower edge, and section bodies truncate mid-control.
